reference: User-provided MapleStory scroll screenshot: side-profile shape; loot-scrolls-v3 shown as old design to replace.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: three pixel-art dropped-item scroll icons for a side-scrolling RPG. Create a single transparent PNG atlas, three equal square cells in ONE horizontal row, no labels or text. One isolated scroll centered in each third, same visual size and same angle; generous empty transparent padding between them.

Reference roles: the screenshot collage of classic MapleStory scroll icons is the SHAPE / CAMERA reference. Match the comfortable SIDE / THREE-QUARTER profile, offset curled ends and recognizable simple S-shaped paper silhouette seen in those small classic icons. The other image of three ornate frontal scrolls is the OLD design to REPLACE: do not reproduce its straight-on symmetrical poster shape, giant medallion, ribbons, gems or metal rods.

Design: each scroll is a modest sheet of paper, partly unrolled, viewed obliquely from the side. Upper edge curls backward to the upper RIGHT; lower edge curls toward the viewer at lower LEFT. The upper and lower curls are vertically offset and not mirror symmetrical. The paper bows inward in the middle, creating a graceful narrow S profile. About 15-degree rightward lean. Show the small dark spiral at the open end of a paper curl. Bare rolled paper, NOT metal-ended spindles. Distinct dark brown stepped outline and a thin pale highlight along the front fold. Whole icon clearly reads at 32-36 pixels tall.

Pixel art: deliberate chunky pixel clusters as if hand drawn on a 36x36 grid then enlarged with nearest-neighbor. Strict limited palette, 3-4 flat tones per material, visible square stair-step edges. Clean, charming old-school high-quality inventory sprite. No fine grain, painterly rendering, dithering noise, fuzzy antialiasing, bloom, surrounding particles, aura, sparkles, cast shadows or backdrop. Keep large clear areas of colored paper rather than filling with detail.

LEFT icon (10%): golden yellow parchment, honey-orange curl underside and cream front edge, one small royal-purple DIAMOND-shaped stamped rune in the middle (a simple hollow angular four-point diamond, drawn directly on paper). Rich gold scroll reads instantly as rare.
CENTER icon (60%): warm vermilion / rusty red paper, pale buff curl edges, dark burgundy underside, one small cream FLAME-shaped angular stamp in middle. Red paper is visibly different from the gold one.
RIGHT icon (90%): pale powder-blue paper, muted teal curl undersides, ivory highlights, one deep-teal simple LEAF-shaped stamp in middle. Cool blue paper with a broad simple silhouette.

Make all three scrolls original designs, very readable and restrained. No numbers, writing, percentages, frames or UI. Alpha transparent everywhere outside the three scrolls. Wide aspect ratio 3:1.
